dialogue.content: はじめましてよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: （こんばんは。お疲れさまです。こちらこそよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. Thank you for your time. Likewise, I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Likewise, I'm looking forward to our session.

dialogue.content: （ケースでリクエストはありますか？）
dialogue.English: (Do you have any requests for the case?)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 慣れてないのでお任せで難しすぎない感じであれば助かります。よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I'm not very experienced, so I'll leave it up to you. Something that isn't too difficult would be helpful. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 承知しました。
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I'm looking forward to it.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Likewise.

dialogue.content: 相談に来てくれてありがとうございます。はじめに年齢、性別よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 20歳、女性です
dialogue.English: I'm 20 years old, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日の相談したいことよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Could you please tell me what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 友だちについてです
dialogue.English: It's about my friends.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。友達について、悩んでおられるんですね。お名前はなんと呼んだらいいですか❔
dialogue.English: Thank you. So you're having some concerns about your friends. What should I call you?

dialogue.content: リコでお願いします
dialogue.English: Please call me Riko.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。リコさんと、お呼びしますね
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll call you Riko, then.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 友達についての、お悩みもう少し詳しくお聴きしても大丈夫ですか❔
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I asked you a bit more about your concerns regarding friends?

dialogue.content: 大学に入ってずっとリモート講義で、誰とも知り合えなかったので淋しかったんですが
dialogue.English: Since entering university, all my classes have been remote, so I couldn't get to know anyone and felt lonely, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 最近やっと一人友だちができて、その子のグループに入れてもらったんです
dialogue.English: But recently, I finally made one friend, and she invited me to join her group.

dialogue.content: でもグループになると話せなくて
dialogue.English: But when I'm in the group, I can't seem to talk.

dialogue.content: 大学に入られてからずっとリモートで中々お友達出来なくて最近お友達ができたんですね
dialogue.English: Since starting university, it's been remote, so it was hard to make friends, but you recently made one, right?

dialogue.content: グループだとお話しできないのはお辛そうですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like it's difficult for you, not being able to speak when you're in the group.

dialogue.content: はい。でも話せないとグループの他の人から、リコ居る？死んだ？とか言われちゃって
dialogue.English: Yes. But when I don't speak, other people in the group say things like, “Riko, are you there? Are you dead?”

dialogue.content: いないことにされてしまうんです
dialogue.English: It's like they pretend I'm not even there.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかそれは、辛いですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: ついていけないんです。ポンポンやり取りしてて
dialogue.English: I just can't keep up. Their exchanges go back and forth so quickly.

dialogue.content: 居るのにいないことにされて、言葉で傷つきますよね
dialogue.English: Being treated as if you're not there even though you are—those words are hurtful, aren't they?

dialogue.content: はい・・
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: リコさんはグループだと、そのてんぽについていけない状態でいい方法があればと思って今回相談に来られた感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: Riko, is it that you're having trouble keeping up with the pace of the group, and you came to counseling today hoping to find a good way to handle that?

dialogue.content: うーん・・と言うより
dialogue.English: Umm... it's more like...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 間違えてまとめてしまっていたらご指摘お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: If I've summarized it incorrectly, please correct me.

dialogue.content: どうして自分はそんな風にいつもバカにされてしまうのかな、と思って
dialogue.English: I keep wondering why I always end up being made fun of like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 発言してないだけで死んだことにされちゃうし
dialogue.English: Just because I'm not saying anything, they treat me like I'm dead.

dialogue.content: 死んだのとかは言い過ぎですし辛いお気持ちが伝わってきます
dialogue.English: Saying things like 'are you dead' is going too far. I can tell how much that hurts you.

dialogue.content: 私抜きで遊びに行く相談もしてるみたいです
dialogue.English: It seems like they also make plans to hang out without me.

dialogue.content: それは、辛いですね。
dialogue.English: That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: 一緒に遊びに行けたらいいと思うのにのけ者にされちゃうのは嫌ですもんね
dialogue.English: You'd like to be able to go out together, so being excluded like that feels awful, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: なんでこうなっちゃうんだろうって思ってます
dialogue.English: I just keep wondering why it ends up like this.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's understandable.

dialogue.content: 最初からグループだとそんな感じになってましたか❔
dialogue.English: Was it like that from the very beginning when you joined the group?

dialogue.content: そうですね。テンション高くて圧倒される感じがして
dialogue.English: Yes, it was. They're so high-energy, I felt kind of overwhelmed.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それだと、リコさんテンション高すぎてついていけないですもんね
dialogue.English: In that case, it makes sense that you feel you can't keep up with such high energy.

dialogue.content: 自分はそういうキャラじゃないし・・
dialogue.English: That's just not who I am...

dialogue.content: なるほどそうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: 無理に自分変えることもないですししんどくなりますもんね
dialogue.English: You don't have to force yourself to change. That would just be exhausting, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: 変えるのは難しいですね・・でもこのままだとまたひとりぼっちになっちゃうし
dialogue.English: Changing myself is hard... but if things stay like this, I'll end up all alone again.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I hear you.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいのかな・・
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do...

dialogue.content: お辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: This is really painful for you.

dialogue.content: なかよしのお友達とは、グループでは話せていますか
dialogue.English: Are you able to talk with your close friend when you're in the group?

dialogue.content: 一番始めに友だちになった子のことですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean the first friend I made?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: グループでは話すのも難しいでしょうか❔
dialogue.English: Is it difficult to talk with her in the group as well?

dialogue.content: そうですね。グループでいるときは他の子に合わせてるみたいで、
dialogue.English: Yes. When she's in the group, she seems to just go along with the other girls,

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 特に私に気を配ってくれることはないです
dialogue.English: She doesn't really pay any special attention to me.

dialogue.content: それは、淋しいですね。
dialogue.English: That must feel lonely.

dialogue.content: 一対一なら話せるんですけど・・
dialogue.English: I can talk to her one-on-one, but...

dialogue.content: 普段二人だけだとお話しできてるんですね
dialogue.English: So you're able to talk when it's just the two of you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: グループで話せないのはとても辛いですね。
dialogue.English: Not being able to talk in the group must be very painful.

dialogue.content: はい・・
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: そのことについて、周りには中々話せないですよね。
dialogue.English: It's hard to talk about this with people around you, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 周りと言いますと・・？
dialogue.English: By “people around me,” you mean...?

dialogue.content: お友達や家族に相談なんかは
dialogue.English: For example, talking with friends or family.

dialogue.content: 友だち＝グループだし、家族は
dialogue.English: Well, my friends are the group, and as for my family...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 余り深い話とかできる感じじゃないので、話してません
dialogue.English: We don't really have the kind of relationship where we can talk about deep things, so I haven't told them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。深いと話しつらいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It's difficult to talk about deep topics, isn't it?

dialogue.content: お話ししてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing this with me.

dialogue.content: 今日はもうすぐお時間になってしまいそうですがもっとお話ししたかった事など大丈夫でしょうか❔
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up for today, but is there anything else you wanted to talk about?

dialogue.content: 結局私はこのままひとりぼっちに耐えていくしかないんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In the end, do I just have to keep enduring being all alone like this?

dialogue.content: お辛いですよね。グループで話せないと
dialogue.English: It's so painful for you, not being able to speak in the group.

dialogue.content: なかよしのお友達ともそのことについては話すのも辛いですもんね
dialogue.English: And it must be painful to even talk about it with your close friend, right?

dialogue.content: きっと、もうちょっと頑張ってテンション合わせなよって言われるに決まってますもんね
dialogue.English: I'm sure she'd just say something like, 'Try a bit harder to match their energy.'

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 友達は、そういう感じなんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's the kind of person your friend is.

dialogue.content: リコさんは合わせるのはしんどく感じるなら無理はよくないと思うので
dialogue.English: If you feel that it's exhausting to try to match them, I don't think you should force yourself.

dialogue.content: 話してみてないですけど、そう言ってくる気がします
dialogue.English: I haven't actually talked to her about it, but I have a feeling that's what she'd say.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: やはり合わせるのはしんどいですよね
dialogue.English: Matching them really is exhausting, isn't it?

dialogue.content: きっと疲れてしまうと思います
dialogue.English: I'm sure I'd just get exhausted.

dialogue.content: そうだと思います
dialogue.English: I think so too.

dialogue.content: 無理ない程度で合わせられるのが一番いいと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I think it's best to match them to a degree that doesn't feel forced.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談してみていかがでしたか❔
dialogue.English: How did you feel about our consultation today?

dialogue.content: すみませんお時間なのでそろそろすみませんが終了しようと思います本日は相談に来ていただいてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, but our time is up, so I'd like to conclude our session. Thank you very much for coming in to talk today.

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the session. I appreciate it.)
